description: Find recently funded US companies from official SEC Form D filings. Give it search criteria (industry, state, raise size); get back company names, amounts and investor types.

exclude_investment_funds.description: Skip pooled investment funds (VC/PE/hedge funds) and keep operating companies, which make better B2B targets

filed_within_last_n_days.description: Only include filings from the last N days

keywords_sectors.description: Terms to search Form D filings for — e.g

min_offering_amount_usd.description: Skip filings whose total offering amount is below this (0 = no minimum)
